Approaches may include real-time monitoring systems, predictive analytics for disruption management, and frameworks to improve supplier collaboration and responsiveness. 5. CSO APPROACH 5.1 This CSO seeks effective commercial solutions to achieve the Army Manufacturing Innovation objectives outlined in this RFS. Awards will be executed as FAR-based contracts or Other Transaction Agreements (OTA) under 10 U.S.C. § 4022, as determined by the Government. Offeror shall be responsible for meeting all requirements of authority used for selected award type. 5.2 Funding for participation in this program is highly competitive, and proposed pricing should reflect this. Awards will be based on the evaluation results from a two or three- phased proposal process outlined in Section 7 and are subject to funding availability. The Government encourages teaming and industry cost-sharing or investment and reserves the right to: • Award any number of proposals or none at all. • Fund all, some, one, or none of the submitted proposals, or only part of a proposal. 5 DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A.
